# ColivEase

> ColivEase is a Toronto rental platform built around roommates: AI roommate matching on habits, budget and schedule, a community language filter, verified landlords and agents, AI rental-scam checks, neighbourhood scores with commute times, and whole homes you can rent room by room.

- Serves renters, roommates and landlords in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada.
- AI roommate matching on lifestyle habits, budget, move-in date, sleep schedule and interests; roommates can form teams and apply for a home together.
- "My Community" language filter: you see roommates, homes and renters who share at least one of your languages (English, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, Hindi/Punjabi, Vietnamese, Tagalog, Persian, Portuguese).
- Privacy first: profiles show comic avatars; real photos are only shown when both people agree.
- Safety: landlord and agent verification (licensed agents are checked against RECO), AI rental-scam checks on listings, and an AI lease check before signing.
- Every listing shows neighbourhood scores (transit, amenities, safety, schools) and commute times, and whether the host lives in the home.
- Landlords can rent a whole home room by room (group renting): each room has its own photos and rent, renters apply for a specific room, and current roommates can be shown on the listing.
- Landlord mode is reviewed: hosts apply and are approved, usually within 48 hours, before they can post homes.
- Free to join on the web at https://www.colivease.ca/app.html; the app is available in 10 languages and the guides in English and Chinese.
